name: io.github.noahowsh/acesapi
title: AcesAPI
description: ATP and WTA tennis since 2007: sets, draws, rankings, head to head, surface Elo, sportsbook lines.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Your AcesAPI API key. Get a free key with 500 credits at acesapi.com/signup

tools.name: list_tournaments
tools.description: A season's tournaments with dates, surface, status and champion

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Find players by name or country

tools.name: get_tournament
tools.description: A tournament's draw and results, round by round, with every set

tools.name: get_matches
tools.description: Match results by day, tournament or season, with set and tiebreak scores

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming and in-progress matches for the next days

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: One match: sets, tiebreak points, seeds, ratings and what the score says

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: Weekly ranking lists since 2007, or one player's ranking history

tools.name: get_ratings
tools.description: Our Elo ratings, overall or by surface

tools.name: get_head_to_head
tools.description: Two players' meetings, wins by surface and in finals

tools.name: get_surface_splits
tools.description: A player's record by surface: sets, games, tiebreaks, deciding sets

tools.name: get_player_stats
tools.description: A player's season statistics from scores, by round and opponent rank

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Profile, ranking, ratings, career record, titles and recent matches

tools.name: get_player_matches
tools.description: A player's matches with scores and ratings, filtered by season, surface or opponent
